adjudication.definition_reading: The source defines a no-regret criterion using an ordinary nonpositive limit for each fixed comparator. A definition can impose convergence; it is not a theorem asserting all sequences have a limit. Literal finite-real-limit reading is implemented separately by LimitNoRegret.
adjudication.literal_source_universal_claim_present: No explicit theorem that every bounded FTL stream has every fixed-comparator ordinary limit was found on inspected pages14-18. Theorem1.3 states only a finite best-comparator upper bound. The winning-game discussion uses best-in-hindsight regret.
adjudication.original_false_claim_precisely: For every infinite y:N-> [0,1], half-initial strict-past FTL satisfies forall u in [0,1], exists a<=0, R_T(u)/T -> a; equivalently, infer LimitNoRegret solely from its upper regret bound or upper-epsilon NoRegret. This is a stronger inferred claim, not the literal finite Theorem1.3.
adjudication.classification: REFUTED_INFERENCE_AND_SEMANTIC_NON_EQUIVALENCE; NOT blanket SOURCE_INVALID for the definition or Theorem1.3
adjudication.definition_prose_tension: If at most sublinear is interpreted only as an eventual upper condition, its identification with ordinary lim<=0 lacks a convergence premise. Preserve this mismatch rather than silently rewriting the source.

definitions.observations: y(0)=0; y(n+1)=1-y(floor(n/2)). One infinite horizon-independent deterministic binary stream.
definitions.regret: R_T(u)=sum(t<T)(x(t)-y(t))^2 - sum(t<T)(u-y(t))^2; B_T minimizes the second sum over [0,1].

counterexample.domain_evidence: dyadicObservation_unit proves every observation lies in [0,1]; meanPredict_mem gives feasibility and meanPredict_prefix strict-past causality.
proof_body_audit: Binary range follows by strong induction from y(n+1)=1-y(n/2).
Pair recursion gives prefix counts; empirical mean at H_n=4^(n+1)-1 is exactly2/3, while at L_n=2*4^n-1 it equals1/3-(1/3)/L_n. Both horizons tend to infinity.
The actual FTL decomposition is R_T(u)/T=B_T/T-(u-mean_T)^2 for T>0, with B_T/T ->0 by a two-sided bound (nonnegative actual FTL best regret and logarithmic upper bound).
If R_T(0)/T ->a, meanPredict_fixedRegret_limit_iff implies mean_T^2 -> -a. Subsequences force -a=4/9 and -a=1/9. norm_num and linarith discharge the contradiction.
The final conjunction independently supplies upper-epsilon NoRegret, B_T/T ->0, no finite real fixed-u=0 limit, and failure of LimitNoRegret.

derived_explicit_subsequence_limits.status: Mathematical consequence of the inspected decomposition and subsequence proofs; not newly elaborated Lean declarations.

does_not_refute: Finite Theorem1.3 upper bound 4+4 ln T
The definition as a stricter convergence criterion
Ordinary zero limit of normalized best-in-hindsight regret
Conditional ordinary-limit theorem when empirical means converge

seven_semantic_slots.objects_spaces: Source generic V subset R^d with real losses. Concrete obstruction uses V=[0,1], real predictions, squared losses, one binary observation stream. It fits the source guessing game. Generic Lean predicates allow arbitrary carrier X, an explicit extension.
seven_semantic_slots.quantifiers: Source fixed u is independent of horizon. Upper property is forall u forall epsilon>0 exists N forall T>=N. Literal predicate is forall u exists finite a<=0 with convergence. Counterexample fixes u=0 and one infinite stream, enough to defeat universal convergence. No uniform-in-u threshold is assumed.
seven_semantic_slots.assumptions_regularity: Concrete counterexample has no stochastic, IID, measurability or limiting empirical-mean assumption. Its [0,1] range is proved, not assumed. Conditional repair explicitly adds empirical-mean convergence; it is a mathematical restriction, not a hidden source premise.
seven_semantic_slots.conclusion_metric: Upper-epsilon, ordinary fixed-comparator limit, and ordinary best-in-hindsight limit are distinct. Only the first and third hold unconditionally for this FTL; literal fixed-comparator convergence fails on the dyadic stream.
seven_semantic_slots.constants_normalization: Source T>=1, initial1/2, bound4+4 ln T. Lean zero-based rounds t correspond to source t+1. High/low means2/3 and1/3 produce fixed-u=0 limits-4/9 and-1/9. T=0 totalization is irrelevant to asymptotic statements.
seven_semantic_slots.probability_feedback: Deterministic pathwise source route allows adaptive adversarial observations. The explicit exogenous sequence is a permitted special case. Predictor uses only strict past; no future access, distribution or probability event enters.
seven_semantic_slots.boundary_exclusions: No minimax claim, source-author endorsement, all-chapter closure or current compiler certification. Finite fixed-comparator convergence is retained only with an added convergence hypothesis or exact equivalent mean-convergence criterion.

separate_corrected_targets.kind: Proposed explicit definitional convention, not a silent source edit
separate_corrected_targets.statement: For each fixed u in V and each epsilon>0, there exists N such that R_T(u)/T<=epsilon for every T>=N. Equivalently limsup R_T(u)/T<=0 in the extended-real sense.
separate_corrected_targets.hypotheses: General V/loss/predictor with regret defined. To guarantee this property for the source FTL: one infinite y(t) in[0,1], x(0)=1/2, strict-past empirical-mean predictions.
separate_corrected_targets.constants: For T>=1, R_T(u)<=B_T<=4+4 ln T for u in[0,1].
separate_corrected_targets.available_Lean: NoRegret and meanPredict_noRegret; the limsup reformulation itself was not elaborated in this review.
separate_corrected_targets.approval: Proposal only. Independent mathematical adequacy accepted here; author/user source-repair approval not established.

separate_corrected_targets.kind: Restricted derived theorem preserving the literal criterion
separate_corrected_targets.statement: If y:N-> [0,1] and its empirical means converge to m, then for every real fixed u, R_T(u)/T -> -(u-m)^2; hence LimitNoRegret on[0,1]. Moreover for bounded y, LimitNoRegret of actual half-initial FTL holds iff there exists m in[0,1] to which empirical means converge.
separate_corrected_targets.hypotheses: One infinite bounded stream; actual half-initial strict-past FTL; empirical-mean convergence for the forward guarantee.
separate_corrected_targets.constants: Exact limit -(u-m)^2, no changed finite regret constant.
separate_corrected_targets.approval: Existing derived theorem signatures/bodies inspected. This added hypothesis must not be attributed to the unconditional source game.

separate_corrected_targets.kind: Existing distinct theorem, not a replacement definition
separate_corrected_targets.statement: For every infinite y:N->[0,1], actual half-initial FTL satisfies B_T/T ->0.
separate_corrected_targets.boundary: Best comparator varies with T; does not imply each fixed-comparator normalized regret converges.

exact_Lean_signatures.BanditRL.OnlineLearning.dyadic_meanPredi:
theorem dyadic_meanPredict_obstruction :
    NoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict dyadicObservation) ∧
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => squaredBestRegret dyadicObservation
      (meanPredict dyadicObservation) T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) ∧
    (¬ ∃ a : ℝ, Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2)
        (meanPredict dyadicObservation) 0 T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds a)) ∧
    ¬ LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2)
      (meanPredict dyadicObservation)
exact_Lean_signatures.BanditRL.OnlineLearning.dyadic_empirical:
theorem dyadic_empiricalMean_subsequences :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => empiricalMean dyadicObservation (4^(n + 1) - 1))
      atTop (nhds ((2 : ℝ) / 3)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => empiricalMean dyadicObservation (2 * 4^n - 1))
      atTop (nhds ((1 : ℝ) / 3))
exact_Lean_signatures.BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict_limi:
theorem meanPredict_limitNoRegret_iff_mean_converges (y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ t, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) (meanPredict y) ↔
      ∃ m ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Tendsto (empiricalMean y) atTop (nhds m)
exact_Lean_signatures.BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict_fixe:
theorem meanPredict_fixedRegret_limit_iff (y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ t, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (u a : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) (meanPredict y) u T / (T : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds a) ↔
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => (u - empiricalMean y T)^2) atTop (nhds (-a))
exact_Lean_signatures.BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict_limi:
theorem meanPredict_limitNoRegret_of_mean_converges (y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ t, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (m : ℝ)
    (hm : Tendsto (empiricalMean y) atTop (nhds m)) :
    (∀ u : ℝ, Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) (meanPredict y) u T / (T : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (-(u - m)^2))) ∧
    LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) (meanPredict y)

    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => squaredBestRegret y (meanPredict y) T / (T : ℝ))

exact_Lean_signatures.BanditRL.OnlineLearning.limitNoRegret_im:
theorem limitNoRegret_implies_noRegret {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hL : LimitNoRegret V loss prediction) :
    NoRegret V loss prediction
exact_Lean_signatures.BanditRL.OnlineLearning.limitNoRegret_if:
theorem limitNoRegret_iff_noRegret_of_converges {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hc : ∀ u ∈ V, ∃ a : ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a)) :
    LimitNoRegret V loss prediction ↔ NoRegret V loss prediction
